candidate.title: Rapture
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina Rapture schematic: isolation of well-barcoded restriction-associated genomic DNA fragments, separate library preparation with plate barcodes, pooling, and bait capture of selected RAD loci. RAD isolation and standard DNA library preparation are components of this target workflow, not additional target methods. Well 1 and Well 2 are illustrative rows, not a prescribed well count. The shared upstream route is instantiated for each depicted plate because the catalogue explicitly retains separate per-plate pools until plate-barcoded libraries are pooled. This is a schematic architecture, not a complete experimental implementation.

states.label: Isolated Rapture DNA library enriched for selected RAD loci
features: The final product is labeled DNA and drawn as plain blue fragments; the schematic does not detail its recovery chemistry.
Catalogue text identifies these isolated DNA fragments as the sequencing substrate, sorted by RAD tags, plate barcodes, and well barcodes.

The readout can identify DNA sequence variants at captured restriction-associated loci and associate them with source wells through the two barcode levels; sample identity requires the sample-to-well assignment.

It is a selected genomic representation: only the targeted RAD loci are interrogated, with bias toward sequence closer to restriction cut sites. Capture enrichment does not establish perfect on-target purity or complete genomic coverage.
